These errors do not mean the captures are unavailable.
Wayback legacy WordPress origin.source_checkpoint: The first CDX response was not saved during the direct probe. Workflow 38985105267 completed its download and independent archive steps but was cancelled while building the candidate, before the artifact upload placed after that build. Dependent run 38991229745 failed to restore its unavailable artifact and acquired no new content. Workflow 334e9952 moved source/checkpoint preservation ahead of candidate generation. Run 38992255338 resumed from the last durable artifact (38975520061); its supplemental-host index step completed at 2026-10-17T01:47:33Z and its acquisition step is in progress. Full CDX index response and acquired HTML bytes are still pending this artifact.
Wayback legacy WordPress origin.interpretation: A distinct historical WordPress host yields additional CDX records beyond the current local URL-key inventory. Query evidence alone is not treated as recovered page content.
